articles.title: James, Doncic carry Lakers past Pelicans
articles.mainIdea: James, Doncic carry Lakers past Pelicans
articles.summary: AFP: James, Doncic carry Lakers past Pelicans. LeBron James and Luka Doncic combined for 60 points as the Los Angeles Lakers went on a late scoring spree to defeat the New Orleans Pelicans 111-103 on Tuesday.The Lakers extended their winning streak to three games after James and Doncic both scored 30 points apiece in the Big Easy to keep up the pressure on Western Conference leaders Oklahoma City and San Antonio.
